US White House Received Al-Qaeda Warning Before 9/11 Attacks

The White House received a warning about Al-Qaeda's intentions shortly before the September 11, 2001, attacks. The warning indicated that "hundreds of Americans lay dead." The coverage does not specify who delivered the warning or the exact date it was received, only that it occurred "a week before 9/11."
